title: InterDigital: Setting Wireless Standards - [Business Breakdowns, EP.166]

reader_summary.headline: Today we are breaking down InterDigital, a really interesting business that sits completely under the radar for most investors.
reader_summary.overview: Today we are breaking down InterDigital, a really interesting business that sits completely under the radar for most investors. InterDigital has the foundational patented technology that makes mobile phone communication and device-to-device communication possible. Everything revolving around 2G, 3G, 4G, 5G, the Internet of Things.

key_points.text: Everything revolving around 2G, 3G, 4G, 5G, the Internet of Things.
My guest is Jenny Wallace, co-founder and CIO of Summit Street Capital Management.
We discuss InterDigital's five decades of history, what it takes to maintain its patent portfolio of 30,000 patents, and much more.
